adelaide-49.name: JamFactory
adelaide-49.bio: Craft and design studios in the West End, with free glass-blowing demonstrations, exhibitions and a shop.

notes.text: Official page: free admission, open daily 10am-5pm, glass-blowing viewing platform free with no bookings, galleries and shop. 19 Morphett St.
notes.pin: Draft coordinates from SATC product geotag; 19 Morphett Street, Adelaide.

adelaide-50.name: West Terrace Cemetery
adelaide-50.bio: Heritage-listed cemetery in the city's west with self-guided trails through 180 years of South Australian history.

notes.text: Self-guided trails are free, 7 days within cemetery opening hours, at least an hour; guided day tours return around the SA History Festival in May; night tours return Feb 2027 (ticketed, not priced here). Run by Adelaide Cemeteries Authority (aca.sa.gov.au).
notes.pin: Main entrance on West Terrace (QR code for the trail guide is just inside the entrance); no coordinates in draft.

adelaide-51.name: Adelaide Holocaust Museum
adelaide-51.bio: Small museum on the Holocaust and the survivors who settled in South Australia, closed for re-curation until December 2026.
adelaide-51.wiki: Adelaide Holocaust Museum and Andrew Steiner Education Centre

notes.text: Official site: closed to the public for re-curation; first gallery reopens December 2026 (education programs continue). Price $10 and hours (Sun, Tue-Thu, booking Tue-Thu) are from Wikivoyage 2023; recheck at reopening. Consider holding until it reopens.

adelaide-52.name: Army Museum of South Australia
adelaide-52.bio: Volunteer-run museum at Keswick Barracks covering colonial wars through Vietnam, open Sundays and Wednesdays.

notes.text: Official site: adults $5; open Sun 11-3 (last entry 2.30) and Wed 11-2 (last entry 1.30), Mondays by appointment from 1 Oct 2026, closed public holidays. Museum is to be relocated from Keswick Barracks to an unfinalised venue, so the pin and bio may need to change.
notes.pin: Keswick Army Barracks, Gate 4, Anzac Highway (agency address); draft point from Wikivoyage geotag.

adelaide-53.name: Bay Discovery Centre
adelaide-53.bio: Local history museum of Holdfast Bay, housed in the historic Glenelg Town Hall on Moseley Square.

notes.text: Entry cost not verified: the council page returns a bot-wall (202) and the old bay-discovery.com site is empty. Cost fields left null.
notes.pin: Glenelg Town Hall, Moseley Square (Wikivoyage geotag).

adelaide-54.name: The Beachouse
adelaide-54.bio: Seafront amusement centre at Glenelg with a carousel, dodgem cars, bumper boats, mini-golf and waterslides, with no entry fee.

notes.text: Official site: no entry fee, rides and attractions priced individually; open Fri-Mon only at the time of reading (Tue-Thu closed), slides limited to weekends. Free-entry basis used; ride prices not recorded.
notes.pin: Colley Terrace, Glenelg (agency address); draft point from Wikivoyage geotag.

adelaide-55.name: Kaurna Trail
adelaide-55.bio: Self-guided 10.7 km walk through the city to sites of Kaurna significance, told through art and story.

notes.text: City of Adelaide page: easy, 10.7 km, bitumen and pavement, allow 2-3 hours; produced by the Graham F Smith Peace Foundation. Free, nothing to pass through.
notes.pin: A city loop of 10.7 km: pin at the midpoint of the route using the trail map (view the walking trail map on the page); not resolved here.

adelaide-56.name: Belair National Park
adelaide-56.bio: South Australia's first national park, with walking trails, an old government house and picnic areas in the hills.

notes.text: Park page: vehicle entry $14.40 per vehicle, to be paid before entry. 11 km from Adelaide. Check whether the Multiple Entry Parks Pass applies (not changed here).
notes.pin: Main entrance and visitor point off Upper Sturt Road, Belair (draft point provisional).

adelaide-57.name: Glenthorne National Park
adelaide-57.bio: Adelaide's newest national park at O'Halloran Hill, with walking trails across former farmland.

notes.text: Park page: free entry, 17.3 km from Adelaide.
notes.pin: Park entrance/visitor point at O'Halloran Hill (Majors Road); no coordinates in draft.

adelaide-58.name: Sturt Gorge Recreation Park
adelaide-58.bio: Gorge park with the Sturt tillite glacial rocks, grey box woodland and walking and mountain-bike trails.

notes.text: Park page: free entry, 15.4 km from Adelaide.
notes.pin: Draft point is OSM-derived; visitor use is from the Craigburn Farm trailheads and Sturt Gorge entry points; confirm in pin pass.

adelaide-59.name: Anstey Hill Recreation Park
adelaide-59.bio: Hills-edge park above the northeastern suburbs with walking and mountain-biking trails.

notes.text: Park page: free entry, 18 km from Adelaide.
notes.pin: Draft point is OSM-derived; use the main car park/visitor point off Lower North East Road in the pin pass.

adelaide-60.name: Waterfall Gully to Mount Lofty Summit Track
adelaide-60.bio: Steep climb past First and Second Falls from Waterfall Gully to the Mount Lofty summit.

notes.text: Within Cleland National Park, whose fee page lists only accommodation (no entry fee); free. 3-4 hours is the draft's range (unverified against a walking guide). Cleland has 2026/27 closures for pest-control programs, check alerts.
notes.pin: Midpoint of the track between the Waterfall Gully car park and the Mount Lofty summit (OSM route/way); do not use the Waterfall Gully or summit spots' pins.
